meta_title: Deep House Cleaning, However Long It's Been | SN Cleaning Services
meta_description: Deep house cleaning from £27 per hour with professional grade products and our own trained team. Dirt doesn't worry us, and our guarantees cover every clean.
h1: Please don't be embarrassed. We love dirt.
intro: So many people tell us they're embarrassed or ashamed of how their home looks. Please don't be. Dirt isn't a problem for us at all. A deep clean is where we can really show what we can do.

understand.heading: Where our experience shows
paragraphs: If your home has been neglected for years and it needs a massive refresh, yes, we can do that. We know which products to use, and we have the experience to know what's possible to achieve.
A deep clean reaches the areas a regular clean doesn't. That's not because a regular cleaner doesn't care. The time given for a regular clean simply doesn't allow going that deep.

That's also why I don't send just anyone. Some cleaners who mainly do regular cleans are brilliant, and their clients love them, but in my experience they don't perform well on deep cleaning. They're used to the same house and the same plan every week. Our team is trained for the deep work.

different.heading: What's different when you book us

items.title: Dirt doesn't put us off
items.text: However long it's been, you don't need to explain or apologise. This is the work we're good at.

items.title: Professional grade products
items.text: Products from the supermarket won't get you there. We always use professional grade products and know which one each job needs.

items.title: The right number of cleaners
items.text: One cleaner can work up to 8 hours before tiredness affects the work. For jobs of 6 hours or more we send a team. We plan it around the result, nothing else.

items.title: Our own trained team
items.text: Every new cleaner goes through a trial, then works alongside one of our cleaners for two to four weeks. After that we check their work at least three times a week until we're confident in them. Every one of them is insured and DBS checked.

items.title: Our show up guarantee
items.text: Our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or it's free.

items.title: We come back if we missed something
items.text: If the property is empty and someone finds a missed spot after we leave, we come back and put it right, completely free. If you live in the home, tell us within 24 hours.

steps.title: Tell us about your home
steps.text: The size of your home and what state it's in, honestly.

steps.title: We plan the time and the team
steps.text: One cleaner for up to 8 hours, or a team when the job needs 6 hours or more.

steps.title: Our trained team arrives
steps.text: On the day and at the time you booked, with professional grade products.

steps.title: We deep clean
steps.text: The areas a regular clean never has time for, done properly.

steps.title: Check it after we leave
steps.text: If anything was missed, we put it right under our satisfaction guarantee.

promise.heading: Our promise to you
paragraphs: Our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or it's free. An afternoon booking would move to first thing the next morning.

If the property is empty and someone checks after we leave and finds a missed spot, we come back and put it right, completely free. If you live in the home, tell us within 24 hours. Customer satisfaction comes first for us, and that's how we've worked for 12 years.

proof.heading: Learned on the dirtiest homes
proof.paragraph: End of tenancy cleans are usually really dirty, and we've done 7,549 of them. That's where our team learned what professional grade products and experience can achieve.

stories.title: A bathroom that took 4 hours
stories.text: In one Hornchurch property the bathroom had so much limescale it was even on the tiles. It took one cleaner around 4 hours. The next day the landlord and the estate agent were amazed. They had been told the property needed a complete refurbishment.

faqs.question: I'm embarrassed about the state of my home. Will you judge me?
faqs.answer: No. So many people tell us they feel embarrassed or ashamed, and there's no need. Dirt isn't a problem for us at all. In fact, we love it, because a deep clean is where our expertise shows.

faqs.question: Can you clean a home that's been neglected for years?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can. If your home needs a massive refresh, we can definitely help.

faqs.question: How much does a deep clean cost?
faqs.answer: Deep cleaning starts from £27 per hour.

faqs.question: What products do you use?
faqs.answer: Always professional grade products. Knowing which product to use for each job is a big part of what we can achieve.

faqs.question: How is a deep clean different from a regular clean?
faqs.answer: A regular clean has a set time, and that time doesn't allow going deep. A deep clean gets to the areas a regular clean doesn't touch.

faqs.question: Why can't my regular cleaner do a deep clean?
faqs.answer: They might be great at your regular clean. But in my experience, cleaners who mainly do regular cleans don't perform well on deep cleaning. They're used to the same house and the same plan. Deep cleaning needs training and experience.

faqs.question: How many cleaners will you send?
faqs.answer: It depends on how long the job needs. We usually send a team on jobs of 6 hours or more. For shorter jobs, one cleaner does it.

faqs.question: Why don't you send two cleaners for a short clean?
faqs.answer: Every cleaner loses time settling in and finishing off, 10 minutes here, 10 minutes there. Two cleaners losing 20 minutes each is 40 minutes, almost an hour of your clean.

faqs.question: How long can one cleaner work?
faqs.answer: We recommend up to 8 hours. After that people get tired and the work suffers, so for longer jobs we build a team.

faqs.question: What if you miss something?
faqs.answer: If the property is empty and someone finds a missed spot after we leave, we come back and put it right, completely free of charge. If you live in the home, tell us within 24 hours.

faqs.question: What is your show up guarantee?
faqs.answer: We have systems in place so our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or we do it for free.

faqs.question: How do you make sure your cleaners turn up?
faqs.answer: We check on our cleaners early in the morning and again in the late afternoon, so we know they're on track.

faqs.question: Are your cleaners your own team?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every cleaner is part of our own trained, insured and DBS checked team.

faqs.question: How do you train your cleaners?
faqs.answer: Everyone who applies fills in a form and gets scored. The right people are invited to a trial. Then they work alongside one of our cleaners, usually for two to four weeks. Once they work on their own, we check their work at least three times a week for the first one to two months.

faqs.question: Can you remove heavy limescale?
faqs.answer: Yes. In one Hornchurch property the limescale was even on the tiles. The bathroom took one cleaner around 4 hours, and the landlord and the estate agent could hardly believe the result.

faqs.question: Can you clean carpets, sofas and mattresses too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Carpet cleaning starts from £49, upholstery from £69 and mattresses from £39, all with professional grade machines and products.

cta.heading: Tell us about your home
cta.text: Get your price and we'll take it from there.

notes: SOURCES: 'embarrassed, ashamed', 'we love dirt', 'expertise comes out in deep cleans', 'neglected for years, massive refresh, yes we can', professional grade products, team sizing, guarantees and training are from her voice notes and chat statements. The Hornchurch bathroom story was an end of tenancy clean; I used it here as proof of limescale work (the text does not call it a deep clean booking). Wording I added that she should check: 'Be honest,' (step 1 and CTA) follows from 'we love dirt' but are not her words. LEFT OUT: '3 times faster' and 'hundreds of 5 star reviews'. QUESTIONS FOR SILVIA: For a deep clean in an EMPTY property, what is the time window to report a missed spot (72 hours as for end of tenancy, or something else)? For lived in homes, is the 24 hour fix a free return visit? Do you bring all products and equipment for deep cleans? Is internal oven and appliance cleaning included in a deep clean or an extra? Do you give an estimate of hours before booking, and what happens if the job needs more time than booked?
